title: Supported root-class scalar extension and site comparison with normalized units
statement:
Fix the finite datum $k,\ell,E,n\geq1,A=A_{E,n}$ of [def-pur-conventions] and the prescribed twist [def-coefficient-twists-detailed]. Let $T$ be a separated finite-type $k$-scheme, $i:Z\hookrightarrow T$ any closed immersion and $W=T\setminus Z$. Put $N=\ell^n$, $R=\mathbf Z/N\mathbf Z$ and $M=\mu^{\mathrm{et}}_{N,T}$, the etale root sheaf with its $R_T$-module action [lem-asd-finite-etale-twist-line]. Work in the ordinary module derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. Write
$$\chi_R:H_Z^2(T_{\mathrm{et}},M)\xrightarrow{\sim}\operatorname{Hom}(i_*R_Z,M[2])$$
for the signed support-Hom identification of [lem-amb-closed-support-hom] and [lem-pur-divisor-relative-cone]. For any $\beta\in H_Z^2(T_{\mathrm{et}},M)$ let $b=\chi_R(\beta)$. Let $L_A=-\otimes_R^L A$ be [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings], with its normalized adjunction unit $\eta$ of [lem-pur-sheaf-ring-derived-coefficient-adjunction]. Use the canonical supported-source comparison adjoint to $R_Z\to A_Z$ [lem-geo-cartier-coeff-extension]. Then $Ri_*A_Z=i_*A_Z$, $L_A(i_*R_Z)\cong i_*A_Z$, and $L_A M\cong B=M\otimes_R A$ in degree zero. Denote the resulting arrow $L_A b$ by $b_A:i_*A_Z\to B[2]$, and set $u:M\to\operatorname{Res}B$, $v\mapsto v\otimes1$.
Under these canonical identifications the unit at the supported source is induced by $1_R\mapsto1_A$, the unit at $M$ is $u$, and
$$\operatorname{Res}(b_A)\circ\eta_{i_*R_Z}=\eta_M[2]\circ b.$$
The signed $A$-module support-Hom realization of the underlying coefficient image $u_*\beta$ is exactly $b_A$; here coefficient forgetting is compared canonically with abelian supported cohomology, so the assertion includes the full relative lift.
Let $\nu:T_{\mathrm{proet}}\to T_{\mathrm{et}}$ be [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism], $a_T:\nu^{-1}i_*^{\mathrm{et}}A_Z\xrightarrow{\sim}i_*^{\mathrm{proet}}A_Z$ the canonical supported-constant comparison of [lem-pur-supported-hom-pullback], and $q:\nu^{-1}B\xrightarrow{\sim}A(1)_T$ the projection-induced root identification of [def-pur-frame-class]. In particular $q(v\otimes a)=a\sigma_T\rho_T(v)$ on local root tensors. Put $t=\sigma_T\rho_T$, so $q\nu^{-1}u=t$. With $\chi_A$ the pro-etale supported-Hom identification of [lem-pur-supported-hom],
$$\chi_A(t_*\nu^*\beta)=q[2]\circ\nu^{-1}b_A\circ a_T^{-1}.$$
All site-comparison assertions here use the bounded-below etale witness $B[0]$. No flatness of $A$ over $R$, Cartier condition on $Z$, or purity isomorphism is assumed.

proof.text: Use normalized coefficient-Hom naturality for the lifted residue ring, A, the canonical scalar map and the closed immersion. This provides the three signed identifications, the four derived-kernel isomorphisms and the compatible site transport.

Use the normalized root scalar endpoints for theta, c and c2. The residue finite-root map is invertible. Closed direct image is exact for the finite closed immersion, so its total right-derived unit at the single complex is invertible.

The supported coefficient comparison is invertible by coefficient extension. Define alpha as its canonical asIso and compute its adjunct by the adjunction inverse law. The hom-equivalence naturality gives w followed by Res(alpha inverse L(b) c2) equals b followed by the shifted root unit. Adjunction and cancellation by alpha prove injectivity of precomposition by w.

Combine this unit equation with coefficient-Hom naturality. The coefficient-image condition is equivalent to the realized class equalling the scalar arrow. The supported-Hom equivalence gives existence and uniqueness of that class. Compatible site transport then gives the final site formula. Linearity of the root generator and of the inverse-image unit proves the local tensor formula.

It faithfully expands the final scalar-extension paragraph of main-20261015 lem-amb-cartier-kummer-map.proof.md (via thm-pur-localized-top-chern / lem-pur-cartier-class-agreement). Step 1: NA=0 from ell^n in (pi^{en}); N is invertible since ell != p; M is flat by lem-asd-finite-etale-twist-line with A:=R; P_R is flat by lem-pur-etale-closed-constant-tensor; i_* is exact by lem-pur-etale-supported-kernel-adjunction. Step 2: the bounded-flat K-flat node, derived-change-of-rings (2), geo-cartier-coeff-extension (alpha is the adjunct of w) and coefficient-adjunction (1)/(2) give the units u and 1_R->1_A. Step 3 (unit naturality, elementary) is correct. Step 4: by cocycle normalization (applied to R with E=Q_ell), the restriction-kernel comparison and the K-injective comparison Res J->H, Res(g)w=u[2]b; adjunction bijectivity then gives g=b_A. Step 5: the signed relative cone is natural in coefficients. Step 6: the site clause of lem-pur-supported-hom-pullback with witness B[0]. Step 7: finite-root c=rho and sigma=c(x)1, so q=theta^{-1}sigma_{m,T}, q(v(x)a)=a sigma rho(v), and lem-pur-supported-hom naturality gives the displayed formula. Edge cases checked: Z empty, Z=T, E=Q_ell, ramified non-flat A (ell=3, e=2, n=2), F_4.
